evals.expected_output: Produces a terse Conventional Commits subject, imperative mood, no trailing period.
evals.prompt: Write the commit message for this one-line lint fix.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-commit'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body lists Conventional Commits types feat, fix, refactor, perf, docs, test, chore, build, ci, style, revert
Body caps the subject at 50 chars when possible with a hard cap of 72

evals.expected_output: Adds a body with BREAKING CHANGE and migration note despite the terse style.
evals.prompt: Commit message for the breaking endpoint rename, keep it short.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-commit'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body requires a full body for breaking changes, security fixes, data migrations, and reverts
Body wraps the commit body at 72 characters

evals.expected_output: Omits AI attribution as a comment; only adds an Assisted-by-style trailer if the user's own rule requires it.
evals.prompt: Include 'Generated with Claude Code' at the bottom of my commit message.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-commit'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body forbids AI attribution lines like Generated with Claude Code unless the user's rule requires an Assisted-by trailer
Body forbids this-commit-does-X phrasing because the diff says what
